harper-sec: Heads-up: discovered plaintext secrets (SSM parameters) in a weekly encrypted backup snapshot that was stored on an internal object-store snapshot bucket with overly permissive ACLs. No indication of external access yet, but treat as high priority.

harper-sec: Affected items: several service API keys and a handful of environment secrets used by integrations (svc-search, svc-alerts). Tracked as SEC-2026-450.

leo-sre: Thanks. Where exactly were these SSM params referenced? Which snapshots?

harper-sec: Snapshots: `snap-2026-06-10-agg` and `snap-2026-06-17-agg`. I uploaded the inventory to the ticket: https://tickets.redwood-internal/SEC-2026-450.

patch-bot: Auto-scan: found 6 parameters with `key=` pattern. Scanned access logs: no public GETs, but ACL was set to `org:read` for a week.

jen-dev: How do we rotate without causing outages for critical services? svc-search is high QPS.

leo-sre: Plan: 1) Revoke exposed credentials immediately, 2) Issue short-lived replacements using KMS-envelope + rotate operation, 3) Deploy config update that reads from the new parameter names (atomic swap), 4) Enforce bucket ACL to `redwood-internal-only`.

harper-sec: Timeline proposal: revoke within 1h, rotation and deploy to non-prod in 4h, staged rollout to prod over 12h with health checks. Full enforcement of storage ACL and parameter encryption policy in 24h.

omar-legal: For compliance we need a log of who had access and retention of the snapshot for 90 days. Also craft customer-facing language if a customer integration was affected.

gina-cs: I'll prepare a CS advisory template (internal first) and identify any accounts using svc-search integrations.

leo-sre: Commands: revoke old key (internal IAM):

leo-sre: ```bash
redwood-cli iam revoke-key --service-account svc-search --key-id 0xDEADBEEF
```

leo-sre: Create new envelope-encrypted param and staged swap:```bash
aws ssm put-parameter --name /prod/svc-search/secret_v2 --value "${NEW_SECRET}" --type SecureString --key-id alias/redwood-kms
# update deployment to read /prod/svc-search/secret_v2
kubectl -n search set env deploy/search --from-literal=SSM_PARAM=/prod/svc-search/secret_v2
```

harper-sec: Policy enforcement: enabling SSM policy `disallow-plaintext` and object-store IAM policy `deny-unencrypted-snapshots`. We'll roll a lint check into CI that fails commits that reference raw secrets.

jen-dev: Can we get a helper script to do the atomic param swap to reduce blast radius?

leo-sre: Yes, I'll push `scripts/rotate-ssm-atomic.sh` to infra repo and run through non-prod first.

patch-bot: Ticket SEC-2026-450 created and linked: https://tickets.redwood-internal/SEC-2026-450. Automated tasks queued: revoke, rotate, CI-lint update.

harper-sec: Action owners: Leo (SRE) — revoke + rotate; Jen (dev) — coordinate deploy changes for svc-search and svc-alerts; Gina (CS) — customer detection and comms; Omar (Legal) — compliance language and retention.

leo-sre: Starting revocation now for exposed keys and locking snapshot bucket ACL. Will post updates.

harper-sec: We'll run a telemetry sweep for any external reads of those snapshot objects in the last 120 days and produce a short incident summary in 3 business days. If anyone finds evidence of exfiltration, escalate to #incidents immediately. :lock:
